title: x509: add EXFLAG_DUPLICATE with cheap O(1) duplicate extension check
body:
In ossl_x509v3_cache_extensions(), introduce EXFLAG_DUPLICATE flag to signal duplicate X.509 extensions. Add cheap O(1) duplicate check using a bitset with minimal stack memory footprint, in compliance with RFC 5280 Section 4.2.

It might make sense to have a public function that, upon a "generic" EXFLAG_DUPLICATE error, could walk the certificate and report the exact reason in detail via ERR_raise_data().

Fixes #26325
